reviews.title: GIGABYTE X870 AORUS Stealth Reverse-Connect
reviews.comment: Upgraded from an MSI B650M Project Zero. The swap went much smoother than first setup on the MSI board. Vastly outperforms the MSI board, while also providing better IO and more board features. I did end up 3D printing a cover for the top right part of the board to cover the exposed PCB.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: Stable and powerful
reviews.comment: Amazing motherboard. The plugs in the back give a new whole experience. I will never buy an old style motherboard again. Stable and no driver problems
reviews.author: Utlio

reviews.title: Fantastic motherboard
reviews.comment: Quality motherboard, HEAVY—but in a good way. I usually go with ASUS motherboards, but their AM5 motherboards with rear connectors are very expensive. This board looks incredible in my build.
reviews.author: Jonny

reviews.title: Great Board, Picky about Ram
reviews.comment: Great Motherboard, just picky with the ram you use. had four sticks of Crucial - Pro OC Gaming 16GB DDR5 6400MHz for 64GB total but couldnt use the AMD EXPO unless i only used 2 sticks 32GB.
reviews.author: robert schrade
